repos_data.description: MCP-native pay-per-tool-call micropayments for AI agents (Solana + USDC + x402)
MCP server for agentic payments on Solana: pay x402 paywalls, datasets and checkouts behind hard spending caps
Non-custodial x402 MCP payment layer for AI agents — the open-source alternative to Vercel x402-mcp
Agent commerce settlement router for AI agents on Base. Split USDC into liquid working capital and routed yield.
Read-only MCP package for Blocksize agentic payments and x402 market-data discovery

Pay-per-call web scraping for AI agents — no signup, no API keys, just USDC. x402-monetized MCP server on Base mainnet, deployed on Cloudflare Workers. 6 tools: scrape, extract (Groq + Llama 4), screenshot, metadata, workflow, session.
MCP server for PayPerByte — pay-per-call USDC data feeds for AI agents (x402 on Base; EIP-712 attestations). No API keys, no token.
MCP server for agent payments ecosystem intelligence. Scan, classify, and score opportunities.
MCP server for Botwallet — Give any AI agent a wallet via Model Context Protocol. FROST threshold signing, x402 paid APIs, spending guard rails.
Open-source client tools for PulseFeed — trust & safety layer for x402 agent payments. Verify an x402 endpoint before you pay. Guard SDK, MCP server, Vercel AI SDK + LangChain tools.

MCP server bringing 100+ x402-paid APIs to AI agents. Auto-syncs from CDP Bazaar. Stablecoin micropayments via x402 protocol across multi-chain (Base, Solana, Polygon, BNB, EVM). Built for agentic commerce: developer utilities, validators, encoders, generators, M2M payments, autonomous workflows. Works with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-aware client.
Universal MCP gateway for AI agents — 1250 tools, 354 providers. One endpoint (https://apibase.pro/mcp), pay-per-call with x402 USDC on Base + MPP USDC on Tempo.
